ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 90% high-intensity white/cream pixels in the central region contrasted against a 10% low-intensity black/dark-grey border and tip distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white central blob; continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge; high-density black clusters at distal tips; localized dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior pixel angle of 50 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire linear boundary; characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys with high pixel-amplitude variations at the far lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve initiating at the median notch and extending horizontally with a slight upward inflection toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark circular clusters detected around the median notch area and heavy cluster colonization at the lateral fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, horizontal and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the outer lower-left and lower-right visible quadrants of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization or parasitic lesions visible as irregular, textured protrusions at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse yellowish-tan pixel staining (biofilm) visible across the lower-central high-intensity region.
